posts.hook: Amazon is now lobbying New Yorkers on the side of the box
posts.caption: amazon is printing labels on new york shipments claiming a city council bill could add up to $5 to any order. verification files for the claimed riemann proof were posted on an mit math page, and the author of mod_wsgi is building its successor in rust with ai help. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Amazon's New York shipping labels claim a council bill could add ==up to $5== an order
slides.desc: The $5 is Amazon's claim, not a fee in the bill, which targets contractor delivery.

slides.title: Riemann, day three: verification files for the Lean proof are public
slides.desc: Posted on an MIT math page: what independent checking of the proof needs.

terms.gloss: a language in which software checks every step of a math proof

slides.title: mod_wsgi's author is building its successor, Muru, in Rust with AI help
slides.desc: A veteran maintainer documenting the whole build in public as he goes.

terms.gloss: a 20-year-old apache module for serving python web apps

slides.title: Optimizely fallout: notices blame "a third party" without naming it
slides.desc: Troy Hunt: ==you can't outsource accountability== for data people gave you.

terms.gloss: an a/b testing service whose script runs on many big sites

slides.title: Google's search page redesign drops the search button for an AI sidebar
slides.desc: The most visited page on the web is being rearranged around the assistant.

posts.hook: The Nvidia chip scandal now has a middleman, a spy agency and an accounting probe
posts.caption: the nvidia chip scandal widened: sources put a man singapore charged with fraud at the center of the alleged smuggling route, and the sec probe is reported to be looking at accounting. ai server makers are demanding up to 45% more months after contracts were signed, and anthropic kept its ipo banks to four-person teams. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: WSJ sources: a man Singapore charged with fraud was central to alleged AI chip smuggling
slides.desc: Li Ming is described as an associate of Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.

terms.gloss: a firm at the center of the nvidia china chip allegations

slides.title: Officials describe a Chinese spy agency campaign to get AI chips for its companies
slides.desc: The NYT reporting points to an acquisition effort with ==state backing==.

slides.title: Reuters sources: the SEC's Nvidia probe is focused on accounting
slides.desc: The regulator's questions have reached Nvidia's books.

terms.gloss: the us regulator that polices what public companies tell investors

slides.title: AI server makers want ==up to 45%== more, months after contracts were signed
slides.desc: FT: Dell, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro. A signed deal no longer fixes the price.

slides.title: Anthropic kept some IPO banks to four-person teams and logged every file view
slides.desc: It also sought six-month bans on advising rivals, Reuters sources say.

slides.title: Experts: AI makes planning attacks on industrial equipment faster
slides.desc: It reads the manuals and past accident reports that used to take time.

slides.title: Binding of Isaac pulls AI music after players found it in the files
slides.desc: Suno metadata gave it away. The creator says he ==had no idea==.

terms.gloss: an ai service that generates songs from text prompts
